title: Epidemic Spread Simulation
description: Simulate the spread of a virus in a population of 1000 people to understand infection dynamics.

interactions.name: virus_transmission
interactions.description: Transmission of the virus from an infected person to a susceptible person upon interaction.

metrics.name: total_infected
metrics.description: Total number of people who have been infected by the end of the simulation.

metrics.name: peak_infection_day
metrics.description: The day on which the highest number of new infections occur.

metrics.name: final_infected_percentage
metrics.description: Percentage of the population that was infected by the end of the simulation.

validation_criteria.name: realistic_infection_curve
validation_criteria.description: The infection curve should resemble real-world epidemic curves, including a rise, peak, and decline.

validation_criteria.name: expected_final_infected
validation_criteria.description: The final percentage of infected individuals should fall within expected ranges based on given parameters.
